construction: Project-authored closed short clay pan/cover shells, real lap steps, 4 mm arrises, thin closed bedding, segmented hip/ridge caps and closed embossed bronze/gilt terminal seals.
geometryMethod: Adapts the closed two-layer tile shell method previously authored in scene03/scene03-roof-solids.js; dimensions, retained roof sampler, course layout, stamped terminal geometry and material are scene07-local.
materials: Deterministic mathematical neutral ceramic albedo/roughness/pores with restrained colour variation; 0 metalness, high roughness and low clearcoat. Cast terminal materials have real thick rolled rims and pierced raised leaves. No whole-roof exposure or lighting change.
fixedLocalWeatherProfile: The mesh67 roof P(t,u) is retained exactly: x=u*(2.88+3.12*t), y=2*(1-t)^1.65+.28*t^7*(.2+.8*abs(u)^5), z=4.5*t.
retainedRandomStream: Consume the former near-roof 24*(9+2)=264 tint samples after replacement to preserve later maple/forest placement.
copyright: Original reference photograph copyright remains with its owner.
